name: Atlas O 21st Century / True-Track
description: Atlas O 21st Century / True-Track is a three-rail O-gauge sectional track system with integrated roadbed (similar in concept to Lionel FasTrack but Atlas's lower-profile take). Curves are specified by *diameter* (O36, O45, O54, O72) following the O-gauge convention rather than centerline radius. Straights at 10", 5", and shorter fitter lengths. Switches (manual and remote) at #5 / O54 and #7.5 / O72 dimensions. WebFetch was unavailable in this session — many SKUs and section-per-circle counts are unconfirmed; see library notes.

data_quality_note: Generated 2026-05-05 by an agent without working WebFetch/WebSearch access. Geometry math (length_mm = in*25.4; curve length = 2*pi*r*deg/360) is hand-computed and high-confidence. Product codes (SKUs) and source_url values are derived from training-data recall and were NOT live-verified. source_verified_at is null on every piece until a session with web access re-checks the catalog. See docs/library-notes/atlas-o-true-track.md for per-system caveats.
